text:
lina (CS): Quick pulse for Astra this week — customer logged higher latency & a small bump in errors on /summarize (streaming). Need to align on root cause and short-term mitigations. Summary first, details after.

ops-bot: Weekly account snapshot 2024-06-17 -> 2024-06-23:
- Overall spend: `$3.6k` (+12% WoW)
- Streaming share: 58% of token volume
- Routes of interest:
  - /summarize (model=rwd-13b-q8)
    - streaming: p95=520ms, p99=1.05s, errors=0.56%
    - non-streaming: p95=340ms, p99=610ms, errors=0.11%
  - /chat (model=rwd-7b-v2)
    - streaming: p95=150ms, p99=310ms, errors=0.06%
    - non-streaming: p95=140ms, p99=290ms, errors=0.05%
  - /embed (model=rwd-2.7b)
    - streaming: p95=85ms, p99=180ms
    - non-streaming: p95=80ms, p99=170ms

lina (CS): Note the /summarize streaming p99 gap vs non-streaming (~+440ms). Error rate for streaming is also higher. Customer reports occasional multi-second delays.

noah (Eng): pinging @devon and @tia. Early hypothesis: high-concurrency streaming sessions hitting the 13b quantized model causing KV cache churn + GPU memory pressure during long sessions. Also saw queue spikes on the streaming worker set.

devon (CE): Can we split p99 by request length? Also want pool-level GPU util and GC events. If >2500 token sessions are common, tail will blow up on 13b-q8.

ops-bot: /summarize streaming p99 by input-size:
- <=512 tokens: p99=410ms
- 513-2048 tokens: p99=820ms
- >2048 tokens: p99=1.9s (small sample ~1.5% of requests)
Queue backlog for pool sum-13b-stream between 20:10-20:55 UTC: avg_queue=12, max_queue=29. GPU mem pressure alerts: 3 events (OOM-safe evict triggered).

tia (SE): Suggestions: 1) enable prefix caching for frequent intro patterns, 2) increase streaming pool batch_target from 6 -> 12 to amortize overhead, 3) add soft client cap at 2k tokens with client fallback to rwd-7b for >2k.

noah (Eng): +1 to those. Also want to try adjusting KV soft-evict threshold from 0.6 -> 0.75 for the 13b-stream pool during a short canary to reduce thrash. I'll craft the rollout plan.

lina (CS): Devon — can you capture a couple GPU traces during the canary window and check for long kernel stalls? Also we'll ask Astra to route a small percentage of heavy sessions to the fallback 7b.

devon (CE): Yep. I'll take traces and provide pyroks logs. Recommend a 20-minute canary with traffic steering to measure p99 delta.

lina (CS): Proposed short-term customer message: "We're seeing a tail on long streaming summarize sessions. As a mitigation, could you try setting max_tokens_hint=2048 and enabling client fallback to our 7b streaming model for any requests over that limit? We'll run a brief canary and follow up." Thoughts?

tia (SE): LGTM. Include snippets for the client:```json
{ "route": "/summarize", "max_tokens_hint": 2048, "fallback_model": "rwd-7b-stream" }
```

noah (Eng): Canary plan (draft):
- When: Wed 09:00 UTC (10m warm, 20m canary)
- Changes: batch_target=12, KV_soft_evict=0.75, prefix_cache=on for common headers (1-512 tokens)
- Traffic: steer 10% of Astra streaming summarize traffic to canary pool
- Metrics to monitor: p95/p99 by token-bucket, errors, queue length, GPU mem usage, OOM events
- Rollback if p99 increases >5% or OOM events >0 during canary window

lina (CS): Action items: 1) Noah: push canary config Wed 09:00 UTC + monitor. 2) Devon: collect GPU traces during canary. 3) Tia: publish client snippet & CS playbook. 4) Lina: notify Astra PM and request they enable client hint for 48h.

devon (CE): I'll also pull kernel stall profiles and check whether the quant exec path is hitting non-opt paths for certain sequence lengths.

ops-bot: Will post a follow-up with canary p95/p99 diffs and queue metrics to this thread after completion.

lina (CS): anything else? If not I'll send calendar invite and the short customer note. :thumbsup:

tia (SE): nothing else from SE side. :+1:

noah (Eng): good to go. :rocket:
